arxiv-2204-08487.title: Characterizing Observed Extra Mixing Trends in Red Giants using the Reduced Density Ratio from Thermohaline Models Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) , Matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , NumPy ( van der Walt et al. 2011 ) , SciPy ( Virtanen et al. 2020 ) Faci
arxiv-2204-08487.creator: Adrian E. Fraser, Meridith Joyce, Evan H. Anders, Jamie Tayar, Matteo Cantiello
arxiv-2204-08487.description: Abstract Observations show an almost ubiquitous presence of extra mixing in low-mass upper giant branch stars. The most commonly invoked explanation for this is thermohaline mixing. One-dimensional stellar evolution models include various prescriptions for thermohaline mixing, but the use of observational data directly to discriminate between thermohaline prescriptions has thus far been limited.

arxiv-2306-11864.title: Optimal waveform for fast synchronization of airfoil wakes
arxiv-2306-11864.creator: Vedasri Godavarthi 1, Yoji Kawamura, Kunihiko Taira
arxiv-2306-11864.description: Abstract We obtain an optimal actuation waveform for fast synchronization of periodic airfoil wakes through the phase reduction approach. Using the phase reduction approach for periodic wake flows, the spatial sensitivity fields with respect to the phase of the vortex shedding are obtained. The phase sensitivity fields can uncover the synchronization properties in the presence of periodic actuation.

arxiv-2503-06027.title: Empowering Edge Intelligence: A Comprehensive Survey on On-Device AI Models
arxiv-2503-06027.creator: Xubin Wang, Zhiqing Tang, Jianxiong Guo, Tianhui Meng, Chenhao Wang, Tian Wang, Weijia Jia
arxiv-2503-06027.description: Abstract . The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies has led to an increasing deployment of AI models on edge and terminal devices, driven by the proliferation of the Internet of Things (IoT) and the need for real-time data processing. This survey comprehensively explores the current state, technical challenges, and future trends of on-device AI models.

pmc-10696769.title: The association of highly processed food consumption with food choice values and food literacy in Japanese adults: a nationwide cross-sectional study
pmc-10696769.creator: Nana Shinozaki, Kentaro Murakami, Xiaoyi Yuan, Ryoko Tajima, Mai Matsumoto, Keiko Asakura, Shizuko Masayasu, Satoshi Sasaki
pmc-10696769.description: BackgroundHighly processed food (HPF) consumption is increasing globally and has become a prominent public health concern. However, the relationship between HPF consumption and food choice values and food literacy is unknown. This study aimed to examine the association of HPF consumption with food choice values and food literacy.

pmc-11351407.title: Effects of Ammonia Concentration on Sperm Vitality, Motility Rates, and Morphology in Three Marine Bivalve Species: A Comparative Study of the Noble Scallop Mimachlamys nobilis, Chinese Pearl Oyster Pinctada fucata martensii, and Small Rock Oyster Saccostrea mordax
pmc-11351407.creator: Minghao Li, Jiong Wu, Rui Yang, Zhengyi Fu, Gang Yu, Zhenhua Ma, Richard F Lee
pmc-11351407.description: Simple SummaryThis study explores how different concentrations of ammonium ions affect the sperm health of three important bivalve species: Noble Scallop Mimachlamys nobilis, Chinese Pearl Oyster Pinctada fucata martensii, and Small Rock Oyster Saccostrea mordax. Bivalves are crucial to aquatic ecosystems, and understanding the factors that impact their reproduction is essential.

pmc-11574857.title: Assessment of Conjugation Pathways in N-Methylporphyrins that Are Fused to Acenaphthylene, Phenanthrene, or Pyrene: Evidence for the Presence of Alternative Aromatic Circuits
pmc-11574857.creator: Jared
pmc-11574857.description: Acenaphtho-, phenanthro-, and pyrenopyrrole esters, readily available from Barton-Zard reactions of ethyl isocyanoacetate with nitroarenes, were reacted with methyl iodide and KOH in DMSO to give N-methylpyrroles and subsequent cleavage of the ester moieties was accomplished with KOH in ethylene glycol at 200 °C.

pmc-11675653.title: Clinical Readiness for Practice of Nursing Students: A Concept Analysis
pmc-11675653.creator: Kennedy Diema Konlan, Dulamsuren Damiran, Tae Wha Lee, Robert Lovrić, Boštjan Žvanut, Biljana Kurtović
pmc-11675653.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Introduction: The concept of clinical readiness for practice among nursing students is yet to be analyzed, and there is a lack of empirical evidence on its usage among academics and clinicians. Methods: This concept analysis is anchored on a systematic literature review that adhered to the PRISMA guidelines and incorporated the eight iterative steps of Walker and Avant’s concept analysis method.

pmc-11831545.title: Anatomical Variations of the Vermiform Appendix
pmc-11831545.creator: Athanasios Sakellariadis, Foteini Sofou, Dimosthenis Chrysikos, Theodoros Sampsakos-Mariolis, Dimitrios Schizas, Theodoros Troupis, Dimitrios Filippou
pmc-11831545.description: Objective.The aim of the present work is to systematically review and present the existing literature on anatomical variations of the appendix.Methods.Detailed research was conducted in the PubMed medical database, using the terms “Appendix” AND “Anatomical variations”, and 74 articles were initially revealed.

pmc-12692132.title: Bridging Technology and Healthcare: A Bibliometric Review of Assistive Technologies in Hospital Environments
pmc-12692132.creator: Debopriyo Roy, Eleni Gkiolnta, George F. Fragulis
pmc-12692132.description: Today, healthcare systems face many challenges due to the increasing number of elderly people and the complex needs of patients with multiple diseases. Previous research has shown that assistive technologies (ATs), like wearable devices, mobile health (mHealth) apps, and smart monitoring systems, can help improve patient care and make healthcare services more efficient.

pmc-12709694.title: Unveiling the metal-driven death: ferroptosis and cuproptosis in leukemia
pmc-12709694.creator: Zhe Chen, Jieni Yu, Leihua Fu, Jiaping Fu, Zhijian Zhang, Pan Hong, Weiying Feng
pmc-12709694.description: Cell death is essential for tumor cells and can occur due to damage or aging. Traditional concepts such as necrosis and apoptosis do not completely account for it. New forms, such as cuproptosis and ferroptosis, involve metal ion buildup and relate to cell metabolism, signaling, and drug resistance. These forms are particularly relevant in leukemia development.

pmc-12715642.title: Prebiotic Roles of Formaldehyde as an Activating Agent and a Building Block in Solid-State Peptide Modification
pmc-12715642.creator: Jamie C. Thuan, Anuja Koirala, James Pirez, Jun Ohata
pmc-12715642.description: Signal transduction by gaseous small molecules is an essential process in modern living systems, where the gasotransmitters relay cellular signals to bio­(macro)­molecules through covalent bond formation. However, the origin or a primordial version of such signaling events in abiotic worlds has been poorly understood to date.

pmc-12753833.title: Fault feature extraction for centrifugal pump impellers via EMD and cyclic bispectral slicing
pmc-12753833.creator: Xiaopei Liang, Hanxin Chen, Lei Wang, Shaoyi Li, Zhigang Wang, Zhaohui Shi, Xiangying Sheng
pmc-12753833.description: The vibration signal of early centrifugal pump impeller faults is a nonlinear, non-Gaussian, non-steady-state signal with inherent periodicity. These characteristics complicate the accurate extraction of fault features. This study aims to explore a novel feature extraction method for centrifugal pump impeller fault vibration signals.

pmc-12785580.title: Interactive Effects of Genetic Susceptibility and Early-Life Tobacco Smoke Exposure on the Asthma–Eczema Complex Phenotype in Children: 6-Year Follow-Up Case-Control Study
pmc-12785580.creator: Anna Dębińska, Hanna Danielewicz, Anna Drabik-Chamerska, Barbara Sozańska
pmc-12785580.description: Atopic eczema and asthma frequently co-occur, forming a distinct complex phenotype that likely arises from shared genetic pathways and early-life environmental influences. We aimed to investigate whether variants in TNS1 and NRXN1—previously identified in a genome-wide interaction study—influence susceptibility to atopic eczema and the asthma–eczema phenotype and whether early-life environmental tobacco smoke (ETS) exposure modifies these genetic effects.

pmc-13315001.title: Modeling and control of highly pathogenic avian influenza in poultry using network disease dynamics
pmc-13315001.creator: Hamed Karami, Sifur Safuka Chowdhury, Alexandra Smirnova

pmc-13330633.title: From pixels to length: Body length estimation of aquatic macroinvertebrates from digital images for ecological applications☆
pmc-13330633.creator: Anita Szloboda, Zsolt Kovács, José Barquín, Gabriel Singer, Zoltán Csabai
pmc-13330633.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Accurate measurement of macroinvertebrate body length is a key component of ecological research, providing essential data for estimating biomass, evaluating growth rates, and understanding trophic interactions in aquatic ecosystems. Yet, comprehensive datasets remain scarce, largely due to the labor-intensive and error-prone nature of traditional manual measurements – especially when processing bulk, mixed-species samples, where body sizes of individual specimens may range over orders of magnitude.

pmc-13676683.description: is both a help and a hinderance to our future. AI is described as a new frontier in nursing (Tranka, 2025), and a way of transforming and strengthening nursing (Yakusheva et al., 2025).
